name: best_search
description: Joint search for a ROBUST whole-area sweet spot after the 10-seed finding that the old anchor is a wash. Co-varies the axes the isolated sweeps flagged as decisive: undertrained init (iters_initial small, n_train small), wide selection kernel (sel_sigma ~0.5-1.0, the interior optimum), and mid rehearsal (mix_ratio 0.15-0.5), at the known-best gap radius 0.12. Three strong detectors, 5 seeds for the search (winner re-verified at 10 seeds after). 144 combos x 5 seeds = 720 configs x 3 detectors = 2160 rows.
